title: Common mistake: ignoring the returned string
why_it_matters: Forgetting to save the result makes string methods look broken.
explanation: Strings can't be changed in place. Methods like trim and toUpperCase return a brand new string and leave the original alone. If you don't store or use the result, nothing seems to happen.
try_it: Quiz: does 'hello'.toUpperCase() change a variable that holds 'hello'?
